idempotency_law: idempotency_key is unique for one canonical semantic intent.
Exact replay of the same canonical intent returns the prior logical outcome or resumes its durable state.
Reuse of an idempotency_key with a different owner, objective, resource, expected_base_sha or payload digest fails closed.
A worker crash after side effect but before receipt is reconciled by inspecting the actual target state before any retry.
writer_law: GIT_WRITE and ADMISSION require a valid owner-lane lease and global repository-writer fence.
The candidate fence_epoch must be strictly greater than every previously admitted repository-writer epoch for the same canonical writer domain.
A stale fence epoch never becomes valid again after expiration or restart.
Canonical admission binds expected_base_sha and performs fast-forward-only compare-and-set.
If live head differs from expected_base_sha, classify STALE_BASE; do not force update.
